rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image/Gardner score was available to it and avoided fabricating embryo morphology. It did not analyze visible features, but its restraint prevents inaccuracy.
It thoroughly integrated age, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, prior IVF history, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness into prognosis and management.
The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with probability estimates tied to age and clinical factors. Minor issues include some speculative links and broad assumptions without morphology.

Much of the discussion is broadly evidence-based, but several recommendations are weakly guideline-supported or controversial for routine use (e.g., aspirin, thrombophilia screening after a single miscarriage, ERA, growth hormone/DHEA, MACS/testicular sperm based only on age).
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future planning, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard and should be individualized.
